content_of_post_to_comment: Unfortunately, two strength sessions a week, a daily walk, and dinner at 7 instead of 10 outperform almost every protocol sold online. The boring answer keeps winning. It keeps winning because it is the answer.
comment: The interesting part is not that simple habits work, but why we keep searching for complexity. Maybe the real bottleneck isn't knowledge of what to do, but our discomfort with repeating ordinary actions long enough to see results.
